scope: Official City of Brampton public ArcGIS NNP and Census services, ArcGIS Hub neighbourhood pages, and city program publications. No third-party real-estate profile used.

conclusions.nnp2021Population: No published 2021 Census population field found for the 53 current NNP boundaries. Official city Census_2021 layers are 122 Census Tracts. NNP_CENSUS_LAYERS is one Madoc feature with 2011/2016 data.
conclusions.nnp2022Population: 53 current named NNP neighbourhoods have municipal-published Environics 2022 estimates in NNP_ENVIRONICS_2022_PRD layer 0; all 53 names match current geometries, maximal symmetric-difference/union 5.991413258134486e-08, consistent with output numerical precision. IDs do not always match; selected output maps by name back to current IDs.
conclusions.nnpIncome: NNP_ENVIRONICS_INCOME_HSHLD is 52 older polygons with 2016 Environics block-apportioned household income distribution, aggregate and average. It has no median household income. Old dashboard labels confirm Total Household Income in 2016 and Source: Environics 2016. 49 current names match; at least 6 matching names have materially changed polygons. Do not use as 2021 medians or transfer by name.
conclusions.nnpVisibleMinority: NNP_ENVIRONICS_2022_PRD has 4 layers only: Population, Mother Tongue, Work Commute, Language at Home. No visible-minority or household-income fields. NNP_ENVIRONICS_2022 (UAT) contains language-at-home and commute, likewise no ethnicity/income. Mother tongue is not ethnicity.
conclusions.cityCensusStatistics: City Census_2021 has exact 2021 population, 2020 household median, 13 visible-minority group counts on 122 Census Tracts. None exactly matches a current NNP polygon; highest single-tract IoU is 0.9945076549082266. No neighbourhood equals a union of wholly contained CTs at 0.999999 coverage tolerance. Medians cannot be averaged to obtain neighbourhood median.
conclusions.license: 2022 PRD source item and layers provide no separate licence. Public city publisher is confirmed as BramptonMaps, but estimates are Environics third-party product; do not call them Statistics Canada Open Licence data.
